title: Physical availability audit: presence, relevance, prominence
origin: ClimbOS synthesis (original proposal) from the member frameworks; author guidance is cited by finding id, proposed rules are labelled 'proposed'.
decision_task: Where buyers can't find, reach or buy from the business (hours, booking, payment, listings), and which gap to fix first.
exclusions: Instant digital purchase where the site is the only point of sale (use BKP-04)
required_inputs: Opening hours, booking and payment options, listings
evidence_requirements: When and where category buyers buy (hours, channels, marketplaces, delivery apps)
Current channels, hours, booking and payment methods, service area
Findability for key situation searches and on marketplace or listing pages

decision_branches.if: Buyers want to book outside hours
Sales and servicing share one channel

implementation_steps: Presence: list buying occasions and check coverage (hours, channels, area, marketplaces)
Relevance: check entry formats, price points and payment options
Prominence: check findability in search, maps, marketplaces and listings, including thumbnail legibility
Rank gaps by occasions lost and cost to fix
Fix blocking gaps before a demand play
dependencies: A list of buying occasions (can come from the CEP map, K2)

cash_and_labor_requirements.cash: Varies; many fixes are free (hours, booking link, listing)
cash_and_labor_requirements.measurement: New-customer source channel; abandoned enquiries outside hours

metrics: Share of inquiries arriving outside staffed hours
Listing or search presence for key situation queries
guardrails: Each added channel weighed against its cost and margin
Don't remove a sales channel without source data
Don't recommend scarcity tactics without evidence
alternatives_when_constrained: No source data: add a 'how did you book' field first
stop_conditions: Review after adding a channel: did it add new buyers or just move existing ones?
review_triggers: Owner's numbers or business type change
A dated benchmark this playbook mentions is superseded
Capacity limits make more presence pointless
Channel fees can erase margin (run the margin calculator)

contextual_heuristic.rule: proposed: Before a demand play, run a three-part availability check (presence, relevance, prominence) and fix blocking gaps first.
proposed: Don't recommend removing a channel new customers buy through without measuring where new customers came from.

strategic_preference.rule: proposed: Don't recommend restricting distribution to create exclusivity; source exclusivity from price, quality and craft.

economic_feasibility.rule: proposed: Add an online channel by the share of occasions it covers and its economics, starting with products bought comfortably online.
